podcast.title: Homage in "I'll Be Missing You" (1997)
podcast.body: The late Biggie Smalls was honored by Puff Daddy's chart-topping homage, "I'll Be Missing You," which was spawned by The Police's "Every Breath You Take" 14 years after its release. "Fourteen years later, every breath you take even spawned puff daddies chart topping homage to the late Biggie Smalls, I'll be missing you."

podcast.body: Biggie Smalls was the "hip hop comrade" to whom Sean Combs (Puff Daddy) dedicated his 1997 number one hit "I'll Be Missing You." The song was released as a tribute to the late rapper. "his tribute to his hip hop comrade Biggie Smalls."

xref.title: NYC Court Date Continuance (July 31 to November 4, 1998)
xref.body: His New York attorney, Robert Kalina (who also represented Biggie Smalls and Run DMC), successfully argued that Wyland was unable to appear for his July 31 court date because he was in rehab in California. Judge Thomas Farber and District Attorney Christine Hatfield agreed to postpone the hearing until November 4, 1998. "Wylandt's New York attorney, Robert Kalina, who worked with rap artists like Biggie Smalls and run DMC, successfully convinced the court that Wylandt was unable to appear because he was in fact in rehab again in California."
